Strap in (or don't) — Heels Dance Class is stomping onto the Main Floor. 🔥👠 Frankie's bringing the choreography, the floorwork, and the kind of confidence boost you didn't know you needed on a Thursday. Beginner-intermediate friendly, zero judgment, all vibes. Bring a cocktail, bring your girls, bring the energy — heels not required but hey, if you got 'em, work 'em. This is the class that turns strangers into a squad by the second eight-count. Azúcar's Main Floor is about to feel like your own personal stage. Don't just hear about it after — be in the room. 💃

Picture it — heels clicking on the Main Floor, a full mirror wall catching every angle, and Frankie counting you into a choreography that makes you feel unstoppable. 🖤✨ Cocktail sweating in one hand, confidence building in the other with every step. The bass is low, the energy's electric, and by the end you're not walking out — you're strutting out. This is the kind of Thursday that rewires your whole week. Whether you've been in heels since you could walk or you've never laced up a strap, the floor doesn't care — it just wants your energy. 💋

No heels? No dance background? No problem. 💖 This one's for every body, every skill level, every first-timer who's been too nervous to try. Frankie built this class low-pressure on purpose — beginner-intermediate friendly, heels not required, judgment left at the door. Come as you are, leave feeling like a whole star. This is Azúcar's Main Floor at its most welcoming: a room full of people learning together, sweating together, laughing at the mess-ups together. Bring a friend or make new ones — either way you're walking out with more confidence than you walked in with. This is community, choreographed. 🕺💃
